title: Transgenic dCas9-DNMT3A mouse lines enable ex vivo and in vivo methylation editing with locus-dependent transcriptional effects
authors: Kalomoiri M; Sorini C; Vos S; Camargo A; Tsalikou A; Krstic A; Prakash CR; Svenningsson P; Needhamsen M; Pahlevan Kakhki M; Kular L; Jagodic M
one_liner_zh: 该文开发dCas9-DNMT3A转基因小鼠系进行位点特异性DNA甲基化编辑，虽涉及DNA修饰与基因表达，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: The number of epigenome-wide association studies linking CpG DNA methylation with disease, traits and exposures, continues to rise. Despite the rapid development of epigenome editing tools, establishing causation remains challenging, particularly in vivo . In this study, we developed and characterized three Cre-dependent CRISPR-based mouse lines that enable locus-specific DNA methylation deposition by either constitutive or inducible dCas9-DNMT3A expression. We demonstrate robust highly locus-specific DNA methylation deposition at MHC class II ( H2-Ab1) and interleukin 6 ( Il6) genes in bone marrow-derived myeloid cells ex vivo . Moreover, neuron-specific methylation targeting resulted in reduced cannabinoid receptor 1 ( Cnr1 ) expression in striatal neurons in vivo . Notably, we demonstrate that the causal effect of DNA methylation on gene expression is locus-dependent, reinforcing the necessity of such editing tools for detailed understanding of the role of DNA methylation and for addressing the causality of disease-associated CpGs.
abstract_zh: 将CpG DNA甲基化与疾病、性状及暴露因素相关联的表观基因组关联研究数量持续增长。尽管表观基因组编辑工具发展迅速，但确立因果关系仍具挑战性，尤其是在体内环境中。在本研究中，我们开发并表征了三种基于Cre依赖的CRISPR小鼠品系，通过组成型或诱导型dCas9-DNMT3A表达实现位点特异性DNA甲基化沉积。我们在离体骨髓来源的髓系细胞中，证明了主要组织相容性复合体II类（H2-Ab1）和白细胞介素6（Il6）基因上稳健且高度位点特异性的DNA甲基化沉积。此外，神经元特异性甲基化靶向导致体内纹状体神经元中大麻素受体1（Cnr1）表达降低。值得注意的是，我们证明了DNA甲基化对基因表达的因果效应具有位点依赖性，这强化了此类编辑工具在深入理解DNA甲基化作用及解决疾病相关CpG位点因果性方面的必要性。
